Title: General availability: Azure Log Analytics in Brazil Southeast and Norway East

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics is generally available in Brazil Southeast & Norway East regions.

You can see the full list of available regions on the product webpage.

Log Analytics collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Learn more about Log Analytics and explore additional regional availability.
